blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from Muse's presale list (2026-11-01). Prices appear only where the source dates them within three months. Paragon presale data is still to be merged, and projects sold through private channels may be missing.

Presale means you buy a home before it is built, and you take possession when it completes. This page lists every Vancouver presale project on my list that is scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2029, with the developer, type, size and deposit where the sources publish them.
Vancouver presale projects at a glance

The list holds 22 presale projects in Vancouver with estimated completion between 2027 and 2029: 14 in 2027, 7 in 2028, 1 in 2029. By type, that is 14 condo projects, 4 mixed condo and townhome projects, 4 townhome projects.

1 of the 22 have a price published and dated within the last three months. The lowest published starting price is at W16 by Olson Kundig: from $979,900. For the other 21, the price is either not published or the price I have is too old to show, so ask me for the current list.
A deposit structure is published for 11 of the 22.
Developers with more than one project here: Wesgroup Properties (2).
The largest project with a confirmed home count is Harlin at 306 homes.

faq.q: How many presale projects are completing in Vancouver between 2027 and 2029?
faq.a: 22 projects are on my list as of November 2026: 14 completing in 2027, 7 completing in 2028, 1 completing in 2029. The list covers projects marketed publicly. Projects sold only through private channels may be missing.

faq.q: What kinds of presale homes are being built in Vancouver?
faq.a: The mix is 14 condo projects, 4 mixed condo and townhome projects, 4 townhome projects.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
